look: Fen Hydra, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Cathedral Hydras family: three-headed swamp hydra. Family anatomy: many-headed swamp hydras whose necks rise like crystal spires. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are green cathedral-glass crystal. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, clear stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
